options.relay_d2: Ubiwizz relay — commission, then use directed D2 control

menu_options.pair_actuator: Pair an actuator (guided; no automatic UTE)
menu_options.commission_existing: Commission an existing D2 relay (assisted; no automatic UTE)

pair_actuator.title: Identify the actuator
pair_actuator.description: Scan or paste the EnOcean Alliance commissioning QR label, or enter the actuator ID exactly as AA:BB:CC:DD.

pair_actuator_type.title: Choose the actuator type

pair_actuator_instructions.title: Put the module into pairing mode
pair_actuator_instructions.description: Draft field-gated mapping: software channel {software_channel} maps to Ubiwizz hardware channel {hardware_channel}; press PRESS briefly {press_count} times. Then make no further physical presses, so local status cannot be mistaken for Home Assistant causality. Continue to start the {timeout}-second directed-D2 commissioning window.

pair_relay_success.title: Directed D2 control confirmed
pair_relay_success.description: A directed D2 ON command was queued, accepted with ESP3 OK, and followed by matching ON feedback from this exact actuator and channel. Persistent commissioning of a factory-reset actuator remains unproven until the hardware release gate passes.

pair_dimmer_success.title: Teach-in sent
pair_dimmer_success.description: Teach-in was sent {attempts} times. No radio confirmation is available for A5-38-08; physically verify that the dimmer responds.

pair_actuator_failure.title: Pairing timed out
pair_actuator_failure.description: Commissioning was not proven. Retry changes nothing. For a new device, Keep may save the default switch without claiming commissioning; Cancel discards it. For an existing device, Keep or Cancel leaves its row untouched and never deletes it.

qr_code.title: Add via QR code
qr_code.description: Configuration only: this radio-silent path does not commission a factory-fresh actuator. Already-commissioned modules can use it. For a new Ubiwizz use guided pairing. Existing UI default relays on channel 0 or 1 use the separate assisted commissioning path: it binds an exact physical QR/ID before any radio and requires a manual relay-profile confirmation when exact radio evidence is absent.

device_form.title: Name the captured device

data_description.manual_eep: Leave empty to keep the profile unknown. Format XX-XX-XX, e.g. A5-12-01. A typed profile is recorded as an operator assertion, never as proof.

device_details.title: Device details
device_details.description: Captured EnOcean ID: {captured_id}, name: {name}. QR add configures only and sends no commissioning radio.

import_yaml.title: Import YAML devices
import_yaml.description:
Ready to import: {binary_sensors} binary sensors and {switches} switches. {non_importable} devices use unsupported YAML platforms and will remain in YAML; {invalid} invalid or partial rows will be ignored.

Do not remove YAML before importing. After importing, remove the imported YAML blocks, restart Home Assistant, and verify the entities. Entity IDs and automations are preserved.

data.confirm: I understand and want to import

import_yaml_success.title: YAML devices imported
import_yaml_success.description:
Imported: {imported}. Skipped as duplicates: {skipped}.

Now remove the imported YAML blocks, restart Home Assistant, and verify the entities and automations.

commission_existing.title: Commission an existing D2 relay (assisted)
commission_existing.description: Choose one UI-managed default relay on channel 0 or 1. Selection is not identity proof and sends no radio. Rows with contradictory radio/product evidence are excluded. The next step binds a physical QR/ID to this exact selected row; its entity and registry identity are preserved.

commission_existing_identity.title: Bind the physical actuator identity
commission_existing_identity.description: Selected UI relay: {selected_id}, channel {channel}. Scan or paste the exact physical EnOcean Alliance commissioning QR label, or enter this exact ID as AA:BB:CC:DD. A different sender or contradictory product/radio evidence is refused. This step sends no radio.

data.qr_code: Commissioning code or exact actuator ID

commission_existing_confirm.title: Confirm the relay profile
commission_existing_confirm.description: No exact radio-declared D2-01-12 proof is bound to selected relay {selected_id}, channel {channel}. Confirm only after checking the physical module: it is a relay requiring D2-01-12 commissioning. This is an operator assertion, not radio evidence. It is persisted only after queued directed D2 ON, ESP3 OK, and later matching D2 feedback.

data.confirm_relay_d2: I confirm this physical relay requires D2-01-12 commissioning

ubiwizz_repeater.title: Ubiwizz repeater diagnostic
ubiwizz_repeater.description: Diagnostic boundary only. Choose the profile written in the module documentation and the level you intend to evaluate. This does not identify a Ubiwizz model, observe its repeater state, change its configuration, or send radio.

ubiwizz_repeater_blocked.title: Ubiwizz repeater radio command unavailable
ubiwizz_repeater_blocked.description: Requested profile: {eep}; requested level: {level}. The documented default is disabled, but Home Assistant has no supported read-back and the current state remains unknown. No radio command was encoded or sent, no PRESS procedure is prescribed, and no options or entity were changed. Collect an exact model/revision, vendor procedure, transmit/response capture and a persistent read-back before adding a command.

delete_confirm.title: Remove device?
delete_confirm.description: Remove {name} ({platform}, {captured_id})? This also deletes its entity registry entry.

progress.waiting_for_device: Press the button on the device now. Waiting up to 60 seconds for an unknown EnOcean sender.
progress.pairing_actuator: Pairing in progress for up to {timeout} seconds. Commands are sent repeatedly; keep the module in pairing mode.

error.unique_id_exists: A device with this identity already exists. Teach-in never merges or overwrites an existing device.
error.invalid_channel_rps: RPS switches only support channel 0 or 1.
error.invalid_channel: Channel must be an exact integer between 0 and 31.
error.invalid_sender_id: Sender ID must be 4 hex bytes, e.g. 05:9F:89:34.
error.invalid_qr_code: The value is neither a supported EnOcean Alliance commissioning QR payload nor an ID formatted as AA:BB:CC:DD.
error.invalid_exact_integer: Value must be an exact integer within the displayed bounds.
error.invalid_number: Value must be a finite number within the displayed bounds.
error.invalid_temperature_range: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum temperature.
error.invalid_raw_range: Raw range start and end must differ.
error.invalid_command_frequency: Command frequency must be a valid positive duration of at least one second.
error.invalid_eep: The manual EEP must use the exact XX-XX-XX hexadecimal format, e.g. A5-12-01.
error.commissioning_identity_mismatch: The scanned or typed ID does not exactly match the selected UI relay. No radio was sent.
error.commissioning_identity_conflict: The scanned identity contradicts existing radio or product evidence. No radio was sent.
error.invalid_ubiwizz_repeater: Choose exactly D2-01-01 or D2-01-12 and repeater level 1 or 2.

abort.learn_timeout: No unknown EnOcean sender was heard before the timeout.
abort.no_commissionable_devices: No UI-managed default relay on channel 0 or 1 without contradictory radio/product evidence is available to identify for assisted commissioning.
abort.commissioning_device_disappeared: The selected switch was removed during commissioning; it was not recreated.
abort.commissioning_relay_unconfirmed: The required physical D2-01-12 relay confirmation was not given. No radio was sent and options were left unchanged.
abort.commissioning_asp_not_supported: NodOn ASP-2-1-00 commissioning is not implemented in this integration. No radio was sent and options were left unchanged.
abort.learn_in_progress: A teach-in window is already in progress.
abort.device_form_missing: The device form session expired; start again.
abort.yaml_managed: This EnOcean ID is also configured in YAML. Remove the YAML configuration before deleting its UI device.
abort.no_yaml_devices_to_import: No YAML devices remain to import.
abort.yaml_import_cancelled: YAML import cancelled. No devices were changed.
abort.ubiwizz_repeater_request_missing: The repeater diagnostic session expired; start again.

climate_teach_in_actor.name: Teach in climate actuator
climate_teach_in_actor.description: Transmit the configured climate profile's teach-in telegram to the selected actuator.

climate_teach_in_actor_switch.name: Teach in climate rocker input
climate_teach_in_actor_switch.description: Transmit the legacy RPS teach-in telegram to the selected SRC-D08 actuator.

learn.name: Start EnOcean teach-in
learn.description: Listen for the next unknown EnOcean sender and fire enocean_custom_device_learned once one is captured.

send_teach_in.name: Send dimmer teach-in
send_teach_in.description: Send an A5-38-08 4BS teach-in telegram using the selected light entity's sender ID.

reload.name: Reload EnOcean YAML platforms
reload.description: Reload YAML-configured EnOcean platforms from the current configuration.

serial_communicator_stopped.title: The EnOcean serial worker stopped
serial_communicator_stopped.description: The serial worker for {device} is no longer running: {reason}. EnOcean entities are unavailable and outgoing commands are rejected to prevent a second process from competing for the port. Check the USB connection and logs, then reload the integration or restart Home Assistant once.
